messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~420ms to ~1.2s after runtime rollout v3.9 at ~08:20 UTC. p50/p95 stable. Some clients timing out.
Jonah: Got alerts, same. Canary went to 100% ~08:18. Increase seems focused on requests that trigger auth refresh.
Sam: Any config changes around token TTLs?
Maria: Token cache miss rate increased ~6x for a subset of tenants. IDP call latency a bit higher, but most of the added latency is internal retry/blocking work.
Jonah: New runtime shipped auth-middleware 0.8.3, it now validates tokens synchronously on attach. Could be causing extra calls.
Liz: infra-bot: "deploy: runtime:v3.9 -> kernel-selector:2.1.0; auth-middleware:0.8.3 (sync validate on attach)"
Maria: Repro in staging: flush caches, send bursts (100 reqs @50qps) — ~5-10% hit refresh and p99 ~1.1s.
Jonah: IDP call itself ~120ms, but we do blocking DB tenant lookup + permission-service call during refresh — adds tail.
Sam: Confirmed: 0.8.3 added getTenantPerms sync fetch on token refresh. Previous version deferred this.
Maria: Grepped code and logs: auth-mw v0.8.3 calls permission-service before returning 200 on refresh.
Jonah: Mitigations: rollback auth-mw to 0.8.2; or route affected tenants to older runtime; or change auth-mw to async + serve stale perms for short window.
Liz: Ops can rollback middleware on affected clusters in ~7m. Recommend rollback as immediate mitigation and plan async fix.
Sam: Short-term alternative: bump token cache TTL for affected tenants — I can push config for cohort A.
Maria: Applied TTL=5m for cohort A — immediate p99 drop to ~480ms in experiment, but this is a band-aid.
Jonah: Proceed with rollback plan. Also want a lightweight trace sampling (1%) on token refresh path to correlate if this reappears.
Liz: Rolling back now on runtime-prod-3. infra-bot: rollback initiated by Liz at 08:42 UTC -> target auth-middleware v0.8.2.
Maria: Post-rollback p99 returned to ~430ms on impacted routes. Filing PM-7894 for postmortem.
Action items listed by Maria: revert sync permission fetch; PR for async + stale serve; add per-tenant token-cache metrics + alerts; add deploy gate with auth smoke test; docs for rollback.
Sam: Add a canary smoke test: 1k auth-heavy requests asserting p99<600ms before larger rollout.
Jonah: I'll prepare bisect of commits and attach to PM-7894; also add telemetry flag for token refresh sampling=1%.
Maria: Dropping repro commands in #eng-runtime runbook gist.
Liz: Thanks — closing triage here, moving discussion to PM/postmortem channel. :thumbsup:
